proposals.evidence: Turner ardha half explicitly records Marwari ādho and neighbouring Hindi ādhā, with western ad-/ādh- variants. These Malvi/Nimadi responses to broken are the half/incomplete adjective, a transparent semantic alternative to a break participle. The elicited gloss is preserved rather than silently changed to half.
